title: Cheapest Road Network for the Delivery Region
real_world_story: A delivery platform wants to build the cheapest set of roads that connects all its restaurants and distribution hubs so that every location can reach every other location. Some potential roads are cheaper to build than others. Choosing the right subset of roads with minimum total cost is the goal.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Locations as nodes and candidate roads as weighted edges representing build cost
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Building a minimum spanning tree that connects all locations

problem_statement: Given N locations and M candidate roads, each with a build cost, find the minimum total cost of roads such that all N locations are connected. If it is impossible to connect all locations, print -1.
task: Compute the minimum total cost to connect all restaurants and hubs.
input_format: The first line contains two integers N and M, where N is the number of locations (numbered 1 to N) and M is the number of candidate roads. The next M lines each contain three integers U, V and C indicating a candidate road between node U and node V with build cost C.
output_format: Print the minimum total cost to connect all locations. If the graph is disconnected and cannot be fully connected, print -1.

examples.explanation: Selecting roads (2,3) cost 1, (1,3) cost 2, (3,5) cost 2, and (3,4) cost 3 connects all five locations with total cost 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 8.

expected_algorithm.name: Kruskal's Algorithm
expected_algorithm.reason: Kruskal's Algorithm builds a minimum spanning tree by repeatedly adding the cheapest road that does not create a cycle, giving the minimum connection cost.

hint: Sort all candidate roads by cost.
Pick the cheapest road that does not connect two already-connected groups.
Use a disjoint-set structure to track which locations are already connected.
real_world_takeaway: A minimum spanning tree built with Kruskal's Algorithm gives the cheapest way to connect an entire delivery region with roads so every location is reachable.
